data.label: include
data.reason_zh: 摘要明确给出跨任务经验库与judge离线更新，经A/B验证并在复用前评估，支持持续改进。

scope_support.feedback_quote: Candidate experiences enter the library only after paired A/B validation
scope_support.object_quote: combines three components: five-dimensional verification and repair within each task, an experience library shared across tasks, and offline updating of the judge.
scope_support.persistence_quote: the judge is updated with supervised fine-tuning and GRPO on accumulated image-judgment records and evaluated before reuse
